description_en: Submits a media asset content understanding job
description_zh: 提交媒资内容理解作业
kebab_example: aliyun yike submit-media-comprehension-job --input Medias_:_Type_:_video_,_Url_:_https://xxx.mp4 --job-type VideoBreakdown --job-params ProductName_:_Quiet_Blender_Soymilk_Maker_,_BrandName_:_LiangChu_,_SellingPoints_:_Low-noise_blending_,_One-touch_self-cleaning --user-data NotifyAddress_:_http://xxx.callback.url --api-version 2026-07-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitMediaComprehensionJob

parameters.help_en:
The input material. JSON string with the following structure:

Medias (Array<Object>, required): The list of media assets. Contains 1 to 10 elements. Each element includes the following fields:
Type (String, required): The media asset type. Valid values: video or image (case-insensitive).
Url (String, either Url or MediaId is required): The URL of the media asset. The URL must start with http:// or https:// and cannot exceed 2048 characters in length. Unregistered URLs are automatically registered as media assets.
MediaId (String, either Url or MediaId is required): The ID of a registered media asset. If both Url and MediaId are specified, MediaId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
输入素材，JSON 字符串，结构如下：

Medias（Array<Object>，必填）：媒资列表，1~10 个元素，每个元素包含
Type（String，必填）：媒资类型，取值 video 或 image（大小写不敏感）。
Url（String，与 MediaId 二选一）：媒资 URL，必须以 http:// 或 https:// 开头，长度不超过 2048 字符。未注册的 URL 会自动注册为媒资。
MediaId（String，与 Url 二选一）：已注册的媒资 ID。Url 与 MediaId 同时传入时以 MediaId 为准
parameters.name: input

parameters.help_en:
The job type.

VideoBreakdown: viral video breakdown. Requires Medias to contain exactly 1 element with Type=video.
ProductRecognition: product image information recognition. Requires all elements in Medias to have Type=image
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型。

VideoBreakdown：爆款视频拆解，要求 Medias 恰好包含 1 个 Type=video 的元素；
ProductRecognition：产品图片信息识别，要求 Medias 中全部元素 Type=image
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en: The analysis parameters. JSON string. The total length cannot exceed 65536 characters, and the total number of fields cannot exceed 20
parameters.help_zh: 分析参数，JSON 字符串，整体长度不超过 65536 字符，字段总数不超过 20 个
parameters.name: job_params

parameters.help_en: The custom parameters. JSON string that is returned as-is in the callback result (for example, newsKey). The system reserved field NotifyAddress specifies the callback URL. The callback is triggered after the job is completed
parameters.help_zh: 自定义参数，JSON格式字符串，回调结果原样携带（如：newsKey）。系统保留字段 NotifyAddress，回调地址URL，任务完成后回调
parameters.name: user_data

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code. An empty string is returned when the submission is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 业务错误码，提交成功时为空字符串
